remarks: Welcome to Schooner Cove, where everyday living feels like a waterfront vacation. THIS BRIGHT TOWNHOUSE-STYLE UNIT COMES WITH A RARE 22' DEEDED BOAT SLIP, giving you instant access to Stamford Harbor for fishing, cruising, or soaking up the coastal lifestyle. Use it yourself or turn it into an income-producing asset when not in use.  The home has been well maintained, featuring two brand-new skylights that open to fill the space with light and fresh air. Vinyl windows (2019) improve comfort and efficiency, freshly rebuilt front entry steps add curb appeal, and the carpets were just professionally cleaned. The association has also repaved the parking lot, keeping the community fresh, convenient, and well cared for.  Life here is about more than the home. Residents enjoy a sparkling inground pool and beautifully landscaped grounds that feel like a private resort. Just outside your door: Cummings Beach, local parks, Harbor Point restaurants, shopping, and Stamford's vibrant nightlife. Downtown Stamford and Metro North are only minutes away, placing you less than an hour from New York City while still tucked into a true waterfront retreat.  Opportunities like this don't come often. With water views, a deeded boat slip, recent maintenance, and unbeatable access to both Stamford and NYC, this is more than a home; it's the lifestyle.
